install_hooks.command: requests.patch(f'{self.dana4_api_sdk_url}/tasks/{task_id}', headers=self._auth_headers, json={'status': 'retry', 'progress': 0.0, 'message': 'Agent restarted; re-queuing task'}, timeout=10)
requests.post(self.dana4_api_sdk_url + '/tasks', headers=self._auth_headers, json={'step_name': step_name, 'workspace_id': workspace_id, 'params': params, 'channel_id': channel_id})

requests.patch(f'{self.dana4_api_sdk_url}/tasks/{task_id}', headers=self._auth_headers, json={'message': message, 'progress': progress, 'result_json': result_json, 'status': status, 'cost_usd': float(cost_usd) if cost_usd is not None else None, 'cost_details': cost_details, 'credits_cost': credits_cost})
requests.post(self.dana4_api_sdk_url + '/uploads', headers=self._auth_headers, json={'task_id': task_id, 'asset_name': asset_name, 'file_ext': file_ext})

requests.post(self.dana4_api_sdk_url + '/documents', headers=self._auth_headers, json={'path': path, 'title': title, 'content': content, 'workspace_id': workspace_id, 'document_type': document_type, 'task_id': task_id})
requests.post(self.dana4_api_sdk_url + '/documents/replace', headers=self._auth_headers, json={'path': path, 'content': content, 'task_id': task_id})

requests.post(self.dana4_api_sdk_url + '/documents/edit', headers=self._auth_headers, json={'path': path, 'old_string': old_string, 'new_string': new_string, 'task_id': task_id, 'replace_all': replace_all})
requests.post(self.dana4_api_sdk_url + '/documents/append', headers=self._auth_headers, json={'path': path, 'content': content, 'task_id': task_id})
requests.get(f'{self.dana4_api_sdk_url}/channels/{channel_id}/messages', headers=self._auth_headers, params={k: _rfc3339(v) for k, v in (('since', since), ('until', until)) if v is not None})
requests.get(f'{self.dana4_api_sdk_url}/documents/{document_id}/messages', headers=self._auth_headers, params={k: _rfc3339(v) for k, v in (('since', since), ('until', until)) if v is not None})

requests.post(self.dana4_api_sdk_url + '/messages', headers=self._auth_headers, json={'workspace_id': workspace_id, 'channel_id': channel_id, 'message': message, 'category': category, 'parent_message_id': parent_message_id, 'document_id': document_id, 'new_channel': new_channel})

requests.post(self.dana4_api_sdk_url + '/automations', headers=self._auth_headers, json={'workspace_id': workspace_id, 'name': name, 'workflow_id': workflow_id, 'yaml_definition': yaml_definition, 'params': params or {}, 'schedule_frequency': schedule_frequency, 'schedule_day': schedule_day, 'schedule_time': schedule_time, 'schedule_timezone': schedule_timezone})

requests.post(self.dana4_api_sdk_url + '/workflows', headers=self._auth_headers, json={'workspace_id': workspace_id, 'name': name, 'definition': definition, 'description': description, 'params': params})
requests.patch(self.dana4_api_sdk_url + '/agents/me', headers=self._auth_headers, json={'schema': schema.model_dump(), 'bio': bio, 'description': description})
requests.post(base + '/agents/enroll', json={'username': username, 'bio': bio, 'description': description}, timeout=10)
